name: Bloom
summary: A 19-second anime teaser of the owner's character Bloom: two MiniMax H3 (open weights) takes of one character sheet cut to the owner's track Anime-Genobi at 140 BPM, under a character-scan and surveillance look, with an editable end card. Nothing is generated.

versions.title: The first cut, to the owner's track
versions.summary: The third mix template: a Space.js scan of the character sheet as the pickup, the takes' strongest poses and ninja moves on the beat from the first downbeat, CRT scanlines, a REC / CAM HUD, target boxes and callouts, the wireframe sweep on the drop, the title, and the construction end card with Bloom's own still.
changes: Two takes encoded once at 1920 × 1080, CRF 18, no sound
The owner's track trimmed 40 ms and raised to -14 LUFS; 44.5 beats at 140 BPM, 458 frames
One new recipe, end-card-still: the construction end card with a still parameter
Gallery: Bloom replaces Neon bloom; the Dimensions mix becomes the music video
